distinguishing_features: Segmented tube geometry with integrated mechanical hinges
Localized cross-section changes (necks/collars) to decouple vibrational modes
Transformation of continuous beam into short, independent segments
Raising local natural frequencies via segmentation to exit excitation band
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Preventing flow-induced vibration fatigue in shell-and-tube exchangers by eliminating multi-span resonances and high bending moments at supports without adding external components.
parsed.viable_reason: The mechanism introduces severe, unaddressed stress concentrations and leakage paths at the numerous segmented joints, making it infeasible for pressure vessel service.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Segmenting a continuous pressure boundary with hinges is an obvious but impractical structural modification for vibration control.
